description: The woman wears a floor-length opaque plum-purple gown with a low square neckline and a fitted structured bodice. Wide gold floral woven borders outline the neckline, waist and long front skirt panels. Round gold shoulder clasps sit on narrow straps, while a large purple-and-gold wrap rests along her forearms and falls down the sides with tasselled edges. Cream inner fabric appears between the skirt panels. She wears small gold hanging earrings, a dark-stone pendant, bracelets and rings. A purple-and-gold rounded slipper is visible beneath the hem. Her shoulders and head remain uncovered.
